question: Where are a nature reserve found within 160 kilometers when heading north from Park Hyatt New York, New York, NY?
sql:
WITH origin AS  (SELECT ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-73.979314 40.765422)',4326)::geography AS geometry)
SELECT * FROM pois, origin
WHERE ST_DWithin(pois.geometry, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-73.979314 40.765422)',4326)::geography, 160000)
AND leisure = 'nature_reserve'
AND ((degrees(ST_Azimuth(origin.geometry, pois.geometry)) BETWEEN 0.0 AND 22.5) OR (degrees(ST_Azimuth(origin.geometry, pois.geometry)) BETWEEN 337.5 AND 360));

answers.poi_name: Iona Island Component Hudson River National Estuarine Research Reserve

[3].display_name: Park Hyatt New York, New York, NY

[4].direction_predicate: ((degrees(ST_Azimuth(origin.geometry, pois.geometry)) BETWEEN 0.0 AND 22.5) OR (degrees(ST_Azimuth(origin.geometry, pois.geometry)) BETWEEN 337.5 AND 360))
